correctness.rationale: Direct exact transition P(parent terminal)=L_m/m gives mean m/2 and variance m/12 for m>=3 with initial V_2=0. Conditional regression yields (t-1)/(s-1), hence the cross-branch covariance using conditional independence. Monotone common-uniform transitions prove cross-branch increasing path association. Bounded martingale differences, L1 convergence of their conditional covariance sums, and Lindeberg prove the joint Gaussian law including singular alpha=1. 5761 exact checker assertions verify finite independent enumerations and rational DP; the analytic proof covers all n and limits.

value.rationale: A complete finite shared-history dependence kernel, positive-association ordering, and exact cubic correlation attenuation quantify the memory of a natural observable in a standard coupled-tree model. Rank-one dependence across every pair of future observation times supplies structural information unavailable from one-tree marginal leaf counts alone and motivates its use in paired-network inference.
